summary: V3-08 repair accepted. The candidate repairs the audited must-fix: the stuck-app detector in scripts/e2e-android.js force-stopped a healthy-but-slow app during cold start on API 35 x86_64 (4 real empty-match dumps = 2-4 min, while the documented cold start can reach 240s). The fix adds a time-based cold-start grace period (COLD_START_GRACE_MS = 300s, beyond the documented 240s worst case) that suppresses the stuck-app detector during the first 5 minutes of the Demarrer waitFor, while preserving stuck detection after the grace period and keeping the pidof crash detector active throughout. The grace logic was verified by simulation: a healthy 240-350s cold start is never force-stopped, and a genuinely stuck app is still force-stopped within the 600s timeout. The delta is confined to scripts/e2e-android.js and its contract test (__tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts, +1 test, 452 total); no product code, governance, directives, workflows or release state were touched, so V3-01..V3-07 invariants cannot regress. Trusted verification exit code is 0 (typecheck PASS, 452/452 tests PASS, privacy 71/71 PASS, cost 21/21 PASS, expo export android PASS, prebuild PASS, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 18m42s). Independent re-runs confirm typecheck, 452 tests, privacy 71, cost 21, node --check and bash -n all pass. Limitation documented: the step-7 evidence of run 35552961193 (logcat-wait-*.txt, logcat-failure.txt, dump-*.xml) is not directly readable from this environment — the GitHub Actions logs endpoint returns 403 without admin rights and no factory token is present; the artifacts list for that run is empty because the upload step was skipped after the failure. The root-cause hypothesis was nonetheless confirmed by the previous audit (RUN_35555772885: step 7 failed after 27m16s, gates passed, 15 consecutive identical failures at the same step, detector logic present in the tree) and the fix directly implements the primary remedy prescribed in the task objective.

Each force-stop reset the cold start, creating an infinite kill loop and failing the finalizer emulator step 15 consecutive times.
findings.evidence: Previous audit RUN_35555772885: run 35552961193 failed at step 7 after 27m16s with gates passing; 15 consecutive dispatched finalizer runs failed at the same step. Candidate fix: COLD_START_GRACE_MS=300_000 suppresses the stuck detector during the first 5 min of the Demarrer waitFor (waitFor('Demarrer', 600000, { graceMs: COLD_START_GRACE_MS })); empty-match dumps during grace log progress instead of incrementing the counter; after grace the counter increments normally. Simulation: healthy 240s/350s cold starts -> 0 force-stops; genuinely stuck app -> still force-stopped within timeout.
